tests.name: arithmetic_from_json_unsigned
tests.intent: Probes from_json on an unsigned integer type using number-first dispatch.

tests.name: arithmetic_from_json_integer
tests.intent: Probes from_json on a signed integer type using number-first dispatch.

tests.name: arithmetic_from_json_float
tests.intent: Probes from_json on a floating-point type using number-first dispatch.

tests.name: arithmetic_from_json_boolean
tests.intent: Probes from_json on an arithmetic type with a boolean value via the cold path.

tests.name: arithmetic_from_json_invalid_type
tests.intent: Probes from_json type error on arithmetic type when given a string.

tests.name: std_array_trivial_get_to
tests.intent: Probes get_to for std::array with trivial elements using the loop optimization.

tests.name: std_array_trivial_get_direct
tests.intent: Probes direct get for std::array with trivial elements using from_json_make_array via is_trivial_element.

tests.name: std_array_short_json_array
tests.intent: Probes from_json_std_array behavior when the JSON array is shorter than the target std::array.

tests.name: std_array_short_json_array_throws
tests.intent: Probes out_of_range exception when json array is shorter than the target std::array size during read.

tests.name: std_array_nontrivial_element
tests.intent: Probes get for std::array with non-trivial elements using pack expansion path.

tests.name: std_array_invalid_json_type
tests.intent: Probes type error when target is std::array but JSON value is not an array.

tests.name: std_array_large_trivial
tests.intent: Probes large std::array of trivial types using the loop-based deserialization path.

tests.name: vector_int_number_first
tests.intent: Probes vector of ints conversion benefiting from number-first dispatch inside element loop.

tests.name: deque_int_number_first
tests.intent: Probes deque of ints conversion utilizing the optimized element loop dispatch.

tests.name: arithmetic_from_json_null_throws
tests.intent: Probes from_json with arithmetic type and null JSON value to verify it throws.

tests.name: arithmetic_from_json_double_to_int
tests.intent: Probes casting float json value to integer arithmetic type via number-first dispatch.

tests.name: std_array_nested_trivial
tests.intent: Probes nested std::array of trivial type conversion.

tests.name: std_array_element_type_error
tests.intent: Probes type error when an element inside the std::array loop has an invalid type.

tests.name: arithmetic_from_json_unsigned_boundaries
tests.intent: Probes boundary values for unsigned arithmetic conversions.

tests.name: std_array_empty_trivial
tests.intent: Probes conversion of empty std::array of trivial elements.
